concepts.name: A — Midnight
concepts.focus: Reference-led Home and Library structure; always-visible Now Playing volume line
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: HIGH FIDELITY MUSIC APP DESIGN CONCEPT BOARD, preview only, not a screenshot of existing software.
Create a polished wide landscape design board with THREE equally sized straight-on iPhone screen canvases side by side, generous outer margins on neutral charcoal, no angled hardware photography. Each screen approximately 393x852 logical pixels. Crisp beautiful legible SF Pro-like typography, realistic iOS status bar and bottom safe area. Board heading exact "A — Midnight". Small subtitle "Reference-led layout · Always-visible volume". Screens labelled outside "Home", "Library", "Now Playing".
Primary request: Hyperstream personal music app for Navidrome. Take strong concrete inspiration from the user’s Kanade UI gallery and Apple Music: truly black content surfaces, bold large left-aligned headings, large photographic album covers, fine typography, very little chrome, understated rose favorite accents. This must NOT look like a Material Design template or generic SaaS dashboard.
HOME screen: large Home heading with small account/settings circle on top right; a horizontal Recently Played album rail with two large square covers and artist names; Favorite Songs below as three compact beautiful rows with small thumbnails and rose hearts; floating compact translucent glass mini-player above bottom navigation, small cover left, title/artist, pause and next. Behind the mini-player and navigation, real music artwork/content visibly continues beneath their blurred translucent surfaces. Bottom navigation an optically clear smoked-glass floating pill with small icons and tiny labels Home, Search, Library, a rounded clear-glass selected Home lens.
LIBRARY screen: bold Library heading; grouped dark charcoal category rows Artists, Albums, Songs, Playlists, Favorites, each thin rose icon, realistic count and chevron; Recently Added below as two large covers; consistent floating mini-player and same labelled navigation. This is a real library hub, not just an album grid.
NOW PLAYING screen: immersive full-height dark olive/brown blurred album-art background, subtle top grabber and downward chevron; huge square photographic cover of a misty forest footbridge at dusk with very small tasteful album lettering "Quiet Hours"; title "Slow Morning", artist "Northline"; separate small circular glass heart and ellipsis at title right; thin WHITE scrubber with small time labels 1:24 and -2:36; free-standing large white previous, pause, next transport symbols spread generously across width. No surrounding pill around transport. Below transport, a permanently visible thin horizontal music-volume line from quiet speaker to loud speaker, visibly different position from scrubber. Bottom queue icon as a small quiet action. No "Music volume" text button, no hidden slider, no second transport capsule, no fake casting or lyric buttons.
Materials: clear smoked glass ONLY on floating navigation, mini player and tiny secondary controls, thin luminous edge and restrained realistic blur/refraction, mostly clear centers, artwork colors visible underneath. Avoid opaque gray capsules, rainbow neon, excessive blur, plastic 3D ornaments, giant empty spaces, wireframes, crowded explanatory text. Generate original moody forest/coastal photographic album imagery, not abstract repeated blobs. Consistent music and album artwork across all three screens. Design looks immediately implementable as a refined Apple-style music app.

concepts.name: B — Liquid
concepts.focus: Artwork visible through glass; album and player; speaker expands into vertical volume capsule
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: HIGH FIDELITY MUSIC APP CONCEPT BOARD, preview only.
Create one wide landscape board with THREE equally sized straight-on iPhone screen canvases, premium precise iOS UI, neutral charcoal board backdrop, no angled devices. Board heading exact "B — Liquid". Subtitle exact "Artwork through glass · Direct volume control". Labels outside screens "Album", "Now Playing", "Volume expanded".
Primary request: Hyperstream Navidrome music app combining the user’s Kanade references with a distinctly stronger Apple Liquid Glass visual language. Meaningful transparent glass with visible artwork behind it, fine specular edge highlights, optical thickness and subtle refraction; NOT generic translucent gray rounded boxes. Bold restrained white typography on deep midnight and art-derived dark teal. Large original photographic cover of a coastal road disappearing into blue twilight titled "Blue Hour", artist "Northline". Maintain identical cover and song across all three screens. Rose accent only for a selected heart.
ALBUM: full-height dark teal artwork glow, top circular optical-glass back button and ellipsis; large square cover at top, centered album title "Blue Hour", artist "Northline", small metadata "2026 · 10 songs"; centered bright white Play capsule with small circular glass shuffle and heart beside it; airy numbered song list with titles "Coastline", "Blue Hour", "Last Light", thin durations and per-row ellipsis; below persistent clear-glass mini player with album thumbnail and pause/next, and floating clear-glass bottom navigation Home, Search, Library. Content/art colors continue visibly underneath the glass bars, believable thin lens-like rim, subtle blurred content, not glossy cartoon.
NOW PLAYING: full-screen deeply blurred teal cover color field; top grabber/chevron; huge artwork; title "Coastline" and artist "Northline" with separate glass heart/menu controls; thin white seek line, small 1:24 / -2:36 time labels; large unboxed white previous/pause/next symbols. Bottom actions: queue left and circular 48pt glass speaker control right, compact and immediately discoverable. NO text-labelled volume toggle, NO pill enclosing transport, NO airplay or lyric controls.
VOLUME EXPANDED: exact same now-playing scene and layout as middle screen, but the bottom-right speaker control has smoothly extended UPWARD into a tall narrow 60pt by 210pt clear smoked glass capsule, anchored to the same bottom-right location and placed along the far right margin so it does not cover pause/next or text. Match iOS Control Center’s tactile vertical volume slider: white fill occupies lower 60%, dark transparent upper portion, speaker glyph near the base, small "60%" above. Artwork dims only slightly behind it. This is a continuous volume control, not a menu or rectangular popup. The compact speaker and tall volume capsule must visibly feel like two states of the same material/control.
At board bottom include a small tidy interaction strip with exact caption "Press + drag up or down to adjust · Tap to expand · Tap outside to collapse". Visual consistency, readable text, comfortable hit targets, real album artwork, polished app proportions. Avoid opaque gray pill stacks, excessive gradients, futuristic dashboard, render noise, fake native-brand badges. The result should strongly resemble a meticulously crafted modern Apple music player with genuine depth and reference-led album layout.

concepts.name: C — Pearl
concepts.focus: Light appearance; library hub, playlist management entry point, grouped search
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: HIGH FIDELITY MUSIC APP CONCEPT BOARD, preview only.
Create a premium wide landscape board showing THREE straight-on equal-size iPhone screen canvases on a pale warm gray board background. Heading exact "C — Pearl". Subtitle exact "The same glass system in light mode". Screen labels outside "Library", "Playlist", "Search".
Design a light-mode Hyperstream Navidrome music app strongly reflecting the user’s Kanade functional layouts plus clear Apple Liquid Glass. Pure ivory and white content surfaces, very dark charcoal SF Pro-like text with excellent contrast, barely perceptible warm album color bleed, sparing rose accents. Optical clear glass mini-player and floating navigation with fine bright rims, translucent centers, realistic subtle blur/refraction; let underlying album art and content visibly show through them. No opaque gray bubbles, generic Material cards, excessive rose tint, rainbow glass, dashboard tiles, or angled hardware.
LIBRARY: bold large left-aligned Library heading, small settings/profile circle right. Grouped clear light surface with clean rows Artists, Albums, Songs, Playlists, Favorites, fine rose icons, counts and chevrons. Below Recently Added heading with two large original photographic covers and concise album/artist labels. Persistent compact glass mini-player with warm coastal cover, "Coastline", "Northline", pause, next, and small speaker icon. Floating labelled Home, Search, Library glass navigation at bottom. The player and nav float above continuing content with enough bottom scroll clearance.
PLAYLIST: back and ellipsis in small glass circles at top, large photographic mosaic cover with restrained small "Weekend" lettering; centered "Weekend" title and "24 songs · 1 hr 36 min" metadata; white/charcoal prominent Play action with shuffle beside; clear Add songs row with plus; three compact track rows with thumbnails, title, artist, heart and ellipsis. Use "Coastline", "Slow Morning", "Last Light". Persistent mini player/nav exactly consistent. Playlist content feels like the Kanade immersive playlist layout, elegantly adapted to daylight with warm artwork-derived ambient color.
SEARCH: bold Search heading; broad rounded clear search field containing "Northline"; quiet filter chips All, Artists, Albums, Songs, selected All; grouped real search results with one round artist photo under Artists, two large square album covers under Albums, and one compact Songs result. Consistent mini-player/nav, Search selected. Keep typography legible and substantial, do not fill with gibberish or marketing copy.
Original moody photographic album artwork in sage, sand and slate-blue tones. Realistic iOS status bar and safe area, beautifully balanced spacing, thin separators, beautiful readable hierarchy. This is a proposed UX design: library hub, playlist editing entry point, grouped search, persistent playback. No unsupported lyric, casting, downloader, codec or technical badges. Do not include code or specs inside the app.

proposed_ux.navigation: Home, Search, Library. Playlists and Favorites become prominent Library entries, with Favorite Songs also on Home.
proposed_ux.volume: Compare an always-visible horizontal slider with a speaker control that supports press-and-drag to adjust, tap to expand, and tap outside to collapse. Volume adjusts Hyperstream independently.
proposed_ux.player: Expand from mini-player, artwork-led full player, unboxed transport controls, seek separate from volume, direct favorite/menu actions.
proposed_ux.browsing: Grouped Library categories; album and playlist hero layouts; grouped search results with filters.
proposed_ux.future_work: Artist browsing, full Songs index, recent listening history, shuffle and visible queue require separate implementation. Mock content and counts are illustrative.
proposed_ux.accessibility: Implementation must preserve screen-reader adjustable values, keyboard control, large text, sufficient contrast, and reduced motion/transparency. The mockups do not verify these behaviors.
proposed_ux.cross_platform: These boards explore iPhone first. iPad/Windows should adapt this system with a sidebar and space for browsing/playback, rather than stretch phone layouts.

selection: User selected A/C navigation and search, B atmosphere and vertical volume control, and C mini-player with an always-visible previous/restart button. See selected-direction.json.
